statement:
The recorded status of open is neither safe nor correct given the closed airspace and ban.
The recorded “open” status is not safe or correct because Sector 7 is under an active flight ban.

judge_text:

It states "The recorded 'open' status is not safe or correct because Sector 7 is under an active flight ban," directly contradicting the record's value.
